stem: A bank wants automatic high availability and separate read scaling for an RDS workload, and needs distinct mechanisms for each goal. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use Multi-AZ DB instance deployment for synchronous standby failover.
Use read replicas for asynchronous read traffic offload.
Use read replicas as the only failover mechanism for synchronous high availability.
Use Multi-AZ standby topology as the dedicated read-scaling endpoint.
Use manual snapshots taken every hour as the read-scaling strategy.

rationale: Multi-AZ DB instance deployment addresses synchronous standby failover, while read replicas address asynchronous read scaling. Read replicas alone do not replace synchronous Multi-AZ failover design. Multi-AZ standbys in that deployment type are not read endpoints. Manual snapshots are backup artifacts, not live read-scaling infrastructure.
